title: factorized topology x node-function Mirror code
hypothesis: A shared small node-function bank plus independent topology and node-function Mirror factors will exactly execute four topology/function combinations, including held-out combinations, at lower serialized bytes than duplicating each program; a native Neural Interpreter-style signature is the strongest control and determines whether this is Mirror-specific.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: one shared two-function MLP basis and a two-node graph substrate
mirror_insertion.coordinate: factorized topology ID and node-function ID select graph wiring and the shared node operator
mirror_insertion.logical_functions: four compositions from two topologies crossed with two node-function types
controls: native explicit graph plus Neural Interpreter signatures
shared node bank with hard topology/function indices

task.node_functions: two deterministic one-hidden-layer 1-to-4-to-1 tanh MLPs with frozen generated weights
task.programs: Cartesian product of two topologies and two node-function IDs; one pair is held out from the training/signature manifest and evaluated compositionally
task.learning: no parameter learning; exact execution and serialization screen isolates code-factorization cost

metrics: per-program fresh output MSE versus generated node graph
actual complete torch.save payload bytes for every object

paid_objects: all shared or duplicated node weights

gates.compositional_quality: All four programs, including the held-out factor pair, must have fresh-seed MSE <=1e-10 for Mirror and each control.
gates.compression: Mirror complete payload <=0.80x independent duplicated-program payload in all three fresh worlds.
gates.mirror_specific: Mirror must use <=0.90x the native interpreter signature payload with equal quality; an equal native factorization makes any compression non-Mirror-specific.
gates.failure: Any quality failure or compression/Mirror-specific byte gate miss in at least two fresh seeds.
gates.audit: No separate audit span is opened; fresh program inputs are the locked holdout.

boundaries: function nodes are fixed and deliberately shared
four logical combinations are counted only as tested outputs, not capacity
